site.sitedescription:
The land is primarilly made up of Quatermary Lavas and pyroclasticis.

"Aluaipugua is a small cyperaceous swamp at 2750 m surrounded by grassland with upper montane forest nearby. The swamp is about 500 m long by 250 m wide on the headwaters of a small stream flowing to the east eventually into the Margarima River. The present-swamp vegetation is dominated by Juncus and Machaerina with Hypericum and some ferns common throughout."-(Haberle, 1993)
